title: SMOK Morph 40 Replacement Pods 2ml
description: The SMOK Morph Pod 40 kit is a seamless blend of comfort, style and performance that’s suitable for all kinds of vaper. These replacement SMOK RPM refillable pods come with a 2ml e-liquid capacity and a top-fill design, while strong magnets keep the pod firmly attached at all times. These pods are compatible with SMOK’s bestselling RPM Coils . Ranging from 0.3 to 1.2ohm resistance, the coils offer varied builds across mesh, dual coil, triple coil and quartz configurations for a variety of MTL and DL experiences.
